headline: LEAKED 📸 PHOTOS EXPOSE WIDESPREAD 💥 DAMAGE at US 🦅 BASES from IRANIAN 🚀 STRIKES
text:
LEAKED 📸 photos just DROPPED 💧 showing EXTENSIVE 🏚️ damage at multiple US 🇺🇸 bases in the Gulf 🌊 after Iranian 🚀 strikes COOKED 🍳 everything in sight!! These shots 📷 handed over by active 💪 military personnel reveal a SEVERED ✂️ radar jet ripped 🥩 in half, flattened 🥞 trailers and buildings looking like they got PUNCHED 🥊 in the face by a freight 🚂 train!! Undated 📅 pics from Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦 and Kuwait 🇰🇼 bases where one unnamed soldier 🪖 spilled the tea ☕ saying this is MAJOR 🏋️ damage that hasn't been communicated 📢 to the American public at all!! "We're standing there with our eyes 👀 closed getting PUNCHED 👊 in the face" he moaned 😩 while the White House 🏛️ just shrugged 🤷‍♂️ and pointed fingers at Centcom who stayed silent 🤐 on the whole mess!!

One devastating 🥲 image captures a destroyed Boeing ✈️ E-3 Sentry at Prince Sultan Air Force Base in Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦 that got RIPPED 🪚 clean in half with its tail section crumpled into a tangled 🕸️ mess of metal!! BBC Verify already clocked ⏰ a similar shot back in March 🌼 confirming the radar plane that detects 🎯 and tracks threats from long range now looks like it got absolutely RAILED 💥 by Iranian munitions!! A US official previously admitted twelve personnel 🧍‍♂️ wounded with two seriously hurt 😣 during that attack on the air base while a pair of shots from Camp Beuhring in Kuwait 🇰🇼 show crumpled 🪑 trailers and a massive tent shredded 🧨 into ribbons with smoke 💨 still billowing!!

Another brutal 📉 photo reveals a four storey building at Camp Arifjan in Kuwait 🇰🇼 that got SMASHED 🏗️ by an Iranian strike damaging satellite comms hardware even if the exact timing stays fuzzy 🧩!! Pentagon's own watchdog just dropped a report confirming hundreds of buildings and structures across US bases in Kuwait Bahrain Qatar UAE Saudi Arabia Iraq Oman and Jordan got damaged or straight up destroyed during the conflict!! Equipment losses hit a jaw dropping three point seven billion dollars 💵 while the overall war tab climbed to thirty three point four billion up to late June with dozens of US aircraft wrecked or hurt on the ground!!

Five refuelling tankers specifically got munitioned 🧨 on the Saudi sand while the Congressional Budget Office notes the E-3 Sentry isn't even in production anymore so replacement means coughing up a shiny new E-7 at five hundred million dollars per bird 🐦 alone!! Total estimated battle equipment losses including planes drones and that fancy high altitude defence system sit at one point nine billion with plenty of uncertainty because the defence department ghosted 📵 their requests for hard data!! Repairs and rebuilding plans remain murky at best according to the report while Brian Katulis a former national security guy under both parties clapped back saying America hadn't adequately prepped its defences at all!!

Katulis added there's strong evidence China and Russia may have helped Iran with targeting which means the Trump administration did nothing to fix these gaping vulnerabilities!! He roasted 🍖 them further claiming the costs show how they burned through precious military resources with basically zero to show for it while the bigger wound is to overall US readiness!! The United States had to divert assets from Asia leaving everyone more exposed to China and the munitions shortage is now making Russia bolder against NATO and Ukraine!! Public pressure is mounting on the White House to end this Iran conflict that kicked off February twenty eighth with joint US Israel strikes and the House just voted for the third time to force Trump to stop without congressional approval!!
